# Start test drag sessions with the source document window

startDragSessionForTests now takes the source window explicitly. Folder tests pass about3Pane, calendar tests pass window, and attachment moves use srcBucket.documentGlobal. End through getCurrentSession().endDragSession(true). Preserve source/destination ownership instead of substituting an outer chrome window.

Scope: mail/base/test/browser.
